title: Data for Canada - Orthoimagery Data Packages
description:
This repository provides systems-ready orthoimagery data for Canada, optimized for direct use in cloud-native geospatial applications and analysis pipelines. By standardizing diverse aerial and satellite imagery sources, it offers developers a consistent, high-performance visual baseline without the need for complex pre-processing.

More information available at https://github.com/dataforcanada/d4c-datapkg-orthoimagery/
